note: Authoritative alphabets live in tools/contracts_inventory/model.py; this is a descriptive schema of one materialized surface record.

surface_record.surface_id: opaque stable id 'CS-'+sha256(kind|canonical_name)[:20] (D-0008-06); independent of label/location
surface_record.surface_kind: one of SURFACE_KINDS (HTTP_ROUTE, REQUEST_SHAPE, RESPONSE_SHAPE, AUDIT_EVENT, RUN_LEDGER_EVENT, DB_TABLE, DB_MIGRATION, STATE_MACHINE, STATE_TRANSITION, PROOF_ARTIFACT, UI_SURFACE, PROVIDER_BINDING, CONFIG_KEY, CLI_COMMAND, BACKGROUND_JOB)
surface_record.canonical_name: the surface's canonical name (e.g. 'GET /cases', a table name, an event type)
surface_record.contract_kind: SP0007 registry taxonomy (HTTP_API, EVENT_MESSAGE, DB_SCHEMA, WORKFLOW_HISTORY, PROOF_HASH, ...)
surface_record.parent_contract_id: the SP0007 CT-* descriptor this surface refines, or null for NEW_SURFACE (never a minted parallel id)
surface_record.detectors: detector names that observed this surface

criticality.vector: 8 dims (authority, tenant, data, externality, irreversibility, centrality, proof, historical_obligation) each YES|NO|UNKNOWN — NEVER averaged
criticality.verdict: CRITICAL (any hard flag YES) | ELEVATED (any hard flag UNKNOWN) | STANDARD

surface_record.effect_reachability: {reaches_effect, effect_sinks, self_sink, exactness: EXACT|UNKNOWN} — UNKNOWN is never 'proven absent'
surface_record.consumers: {consumer_token, consumer_refs, consumer_count_observed, certainty: STATIC_CONFIRMED|TEST_CONFIRMED|DECLARED|HISTORICALLY_EVIDENCED|TRANSITIVE_INFERRED|UNKNOWN} — UNKNOWN is a dark-consumer risk, never zero
surface_record.ownership: {owner (capability tag CORE|TOOL|EMP-* or null), primary_source, resolved}
surface_record.claim_ids: [EV-*] the bitemporal evidence claims for this surface
surface_record.material_leaf: the material Merkle leaf sealed into the Contract Genome (moves on material change, not on cosmetic change)
